trial_court: Ld. Trial Court in CT No. 1024/2021 titled as Andor Productions P. Ltd. Vs. Cinekorn Entertainment P. Ltd & Ors.
case_name: M/S Cinekorn Entertainment Pvt. Ltd vs Andor Productions Pvt. Ltd

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: M/s. Cinekorn Entertainment Pvt. Ltd and Mr. Kalapi Nagada, Managing Director
parties.respondent_defendant: Andor Productions Pvt. Ltd and State of NCT of Delhi

facts_of_case: The accused and the complainant entered into an agreement dated 09.04.2019 vide which accused had assigned the complainant various rights in Hindi language of film Kappan, on a sole, exclusive, worldwide and perpetual basis for a consideration of Rs. 20 Crore + GST.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove all ingredients of the offence and establish a prima facie case against the accused beyond reasonable doubts.
legal_principles.held: It has not been able to prove and establish all the ingredients of the offence and could not make out a prima facie case against the accused beyond all reasonable doubts in terms of Section 138 of NI Act.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not interfere with the trial court's findings unless there is grave irregularity or illegality.
legal_principles.held: That impugned judgment and order on sentence passed by Ld. Trial Court has suffered from grave irregularity and illegality and the same has been passed in a mechanical way.

outcome.final_order: Appellants were convicted and sentenced to pay fine of Rs. 2,91,20,000/- jointly as compensation to the complainant.

use_for_drafting: drafting a defence against cheque bounce
preparing an appeal against trial court's judgment
advising client on burden of proof in cheque bounce cases
